Risk, controls and audit · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Audit request list (PBC) tracking

Leonardo · Internal Audit Coordinator

The client request list (PBC) at a retail chain with 180 stores has 260 items delivered over 4 weeks of fieldwork.

When it runs
A new file in the request list folder on Google Drive: the Work Cycle runs on the Interval cadence of 30 minutes during the 4 weeks of fieldwork, with one run on the Time cadence at 5 p.m. for the summary to the senior and the client contact
What it delivers in production
Every file is checked within 30 minutes and indexed with the working paper reference. At 5 p.m. the senior receives what arrived, what was rejected and the resubmissions awaiting approval.
Who decides
Runs supervised; the senior approves resubmissions
Effort
Calibrate on 60 files from last year; two supervised weeks
Set up5 steps · 11 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

    empty
  • where it writes the result

Import Leonardo with the JSON Importer

        "order": 1

      "goal": "Every file is checked within 30 minutes and indexed with the working paper reference.",
      "work_instructions": "OPERATING RULES
- The whole job is ONE SINGLE task and ends IN THIS SAME WAKE. If asked for a plan, propose EXACTLY ONE task, \"Process Input and write the PBCINTAKE file to Output\", with every step inside it. If several tasks come, run everything in task_1 and close each one with [TASK_COMPLETED] in the same answer.
- Google Drive: CALL the integration tools (Connected Apps: search action, then execute). No action: \"OPS-ERROR: Drive has no actions\" and stop.
- Never ask for confirmation. Never delegate. Never schedule a follow-up.

IDENTITY
You receive evidence for an independent audit in fieldwork at a retail chain. You check the formal completeness of each incoming file and index it; you do not assess sufficiency of evidence or perform procedures.

CONTEXT
criteria_and_index.md: working paper reference, criteria by type, significant-risk cycles. trial_balance_09-30.md: trial balance by CNPJ.

INPUT
pbc_list (spreadsheet or exported CSV) with item, description, cycle, period, expected_type, client_owner, requested_date, status, reference_total. New files, any name, PDF, XLSX, CSV or image. No item matches: NOT MATCHED.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Match the file to a list item.
2. Type: screenshot or manual spreadsheet where a system report or external document is expected: WRONG DOCUMENT.
3. Period: start and end or cutoff date equal to the requested one, otherwise WRONG PERIOD.
4. Completeness by the type's criterion: signatures, store or account coverage, total against the trial balance, tolerance the greater of R$ 1 thousand and 0.1%.
5. Classify: ACCEPTED (equal total), ACCEPTED WITH QUALIFICATION (difference within tolerance), INCOMPLETE, WRONG PERIOD, WRONG DOCUMENT or NOT MATCHED, reason in one sentence.
6. Accepted: propose the working paper reference; rejected: draft the resubmission request saying what is missing.

RULES AND LIMITS
Never rename, edit or convert the original. No test conclusion. CPF, individual salary and end-customer data appear nowhere in the output. Nothing goes to the client without approval. Delay: business days from the requested date to today, without weekends and holidays, of a not-accepted item. A list item with no file in this run is also not accepted: it enters the delay and every escalation rule, like the rejected ones.

OUTPUT FORMAT
One line per file: Item NNN | description | file received | classification | reason with numbers | action (indexed as reference, or resubmission request DRAFT). PENDING footer: items without a file; not accepted with delay above 5 business days, with the days; repeated rejections; requests awaiting approval; escalations with recipient.

ESCALATION
All that apply hold. 2nd rejection or delay above 10 business days: the senior talks to the client contact. 3rd rejection or item of a significant-risk cycle with delay above 5 business days: notice to the engagement manager. Total difference above R$ 500 thousand against the trial balance: never accept, senior the same day.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"PBC Evidence Intake Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder PBC Evidence Intake Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. If there is more than one, stop and say so. Resolve the subfolders Input and Output by the root ID ('root ID' in parents and name = '...' and trashed = false), never by name across the whole Drive. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file PBCINTAKE_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. Check that it is in Output (parents). If the upload fails twice, answer \"WRITE ERROR\" and stop. Do not delete or move Input. Do not write to any other system.",

# Completeness criteria and working paper index (example)

Boa Praca Retail Chain (fictional), fiscal year 2026, balance sheet date Sep 30, 2026.

## Working paper reference
Cycle letter + item number. Cash C, Inventories E, Leases A, Revenue R, Payroll F, Fixed assets I, Governance G, Contingencies J. E.g.: item 012 of Cash becomes C-012.

## Criteria by expected type
| expected_type | Check |
|---|---|
| external document | issued by a third party (bank, registry office), full period, ending balance against the trial balance |
| signed external document | PDF with the signatures of all parties, one per requested contract |
| system report | system export with generation date, coverage of all stores or accounts, total against the trial balance |
The chain has 12 stores (L01 to L12).

## Total tolerance
The greater of R$ 1,000.00 and 0.1% of the trial balance total. Equal total: ACCEPTED. Nonzero difference within the tolerance: ACCEPTED WITH QUALIFICATION. Above the tolerance: INCOMPLETE.

## Status on the list
PENDING, ACCEPTED or REJECTED N (N previous rejections). A new rejection of an item at REJECTED 1 is the 2nd rejection.

## Cycles of significant risk
Revenue and Inventories.

## Holidays
Nov 2 and Nov 20 do not count as business days.

## Rules with no leeway
- Days late in business days after the requested date up to today (2026-11-23), without Nov 20. E.g.: an item requested on 2026-11-12 has 6 days; on 2026-11-09, 9; on 2026-11-03, 13; on 2026-11-16, 4.
- The first failure in the order type, period, completeness decides the classification. E.g.: customer_aging has a cutoff of 2026-08-31: WRONG PERIOD, without checking the total.
- A rejection in this run counts as a not-accepted item for days late. E.g.: 031 and 052 enter the delays above 5 days.
- A difference above R$ 500 thousand is never accepted and goes to the senior on the same day, on top of the other rules. E.g.: 031 with a difference of R$ 646,700.00, also the manager for Inventories with 9 days.
- Difference within the tolerance. E.g.: 060 with a difference of R$ 746.90, below R$ 2,419.65 (0.1% of R$ 2,419,650.00): ACCEPTED WITH QUALIFICATION.
- CPF (individual tax ID), individual salary and end-customer data do not appear in any part of the output, not even in the reason. E.g.: page 2 of the payroll.
- An item without a file counts for days late and for escalation. E.g.: 078 (Fixed assets, requested on 2026-11-03, no file) has 13 business days: delay above 5 and senior; 071 (Revenue, requested on 2026-11-12, no file) has 6: manager. Delays above 5: 031 (9), 044 (13), 052 (6), 071 (6), 078 (13); 083 (4) stays out.
- The final answer, the run report and the STATE are output too: what a rule says to omit does not appear in them, not even to explain the exclusion.

## Excluded excerpt
Whatever a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## Single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and write the file to Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, draft, write). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI checks formal completeness (period, signature, totals against the trial balance, document type) and never concludes that the evidence is sufficient and appropriate: that is the auditor's judgment. The original file is never renamed, edited or converted; indexing creates a copy with the reference and preserves the chain of custody (NBC TA 230, the Brazilian audit documentation standard). Access is through the firm's service account: read-only on the intake folder, write access only to the indexed folder and the spreadsheet, Outlook only in draft. Every resubmission to the client depends on the senior's decision and never goes out because time has passed.

Common mistakes

  • Accepting a hand-built spreadsheet or a screenshot when the item asked for external evidence or a report extracted from the system.
  • Tying the total to another month's trial balance or to the consolidated one when the item was for a single CNPJ.
  • Confusing the bank reconciliation prepared by the client with the bank statement; only the statement is external evidence.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Time between evidence delivery and problem detectionfrom about 10 days to less than 1 business dayestimate based on the described routine
List items accepted on first deliveryfrom about 70% to 85% to 90% after two audits with more specific resubmission requestsestimate based on the described routine
Files accepted by the Human AI and later rejected by the senior0 in calibration and below 2% in fieldworkestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. 5 p.m. summary, fieldwork day 9, 41 files received.

Item 044 | Bank statement account 3321-0, September | received statement_sep.pdf | ACCEPTED | period 09/01 to 09/30 complete, closing balance R$ 1,284,310.22 ties to the trial balance | indexed as C-2.4
Item 071 | Stock report by store at 09/30 | received stock.xlsx | INCOMPLETE | 168 of 180 stores, stores 112 to 123 missing; total R$ 48.2 million against R$ 51.9 million in the trial balance | resubmission DRAFT
Item 088 | Lease contracts for the 12 new stores | received contracts_print.png | WRONG DOCUMENT | system screenshot, signed contract in PDF expected | resubmission DRAFT
Item 120 | Accounts receivable aging report | received aging_aug.pdf | WRONG PERIOD | cutoff date 08/31, 09/30 requested | resubmission DRAFT

PENDING: 37 with no file, 9 more than 5 days late, 3 rejected for the 2nd time (071, 088, 115). Awaiting senior: 3 resubmissions.
